runs.objective: You are a careful reader helping a worried family member. Starting from this investment company's homepage, find what the website itself says about withdrawing money, including any withdrawal fees or conditions. Only read and navigate public pages; do NOT fill in, submit or click into any account, sign-up, login or deposit form. Store the exact sentence(s) the site uses about withdrawal fees as 'withdrawal_text', and the URL of the page where you found it as 'source_url'.
runs.summary:
You asked to find the investment company’s public information about withdrawing money, including fees or conditions.
The public FAQ page was reviewed without accessing any account, sign-up, login, or deposit forms.
The site states: “The Company reserves the right to charge a withdrawal fee depending on the circumstances. You can find all the relevant information in the General Fees document. Please review it carefully.”
The withdrawal-fee information was found on the company’s FAQ page.
